slot: F2-WP-604 child lifecycle/generation: stable logical child identity versus concrete execution-attempt epoch
hypothesis: F2 child lifecycle should distinguish stable logical child/task identity from a concrete execution-attempt epoch so late results from superseded/restarted children cannot be mistaken for current results.
counterhypothesis: Existing F2 causal identity, generation and handoff lineage may already close this ambiguity, making another attempt-epoch identifier redundant authority surface.
